faq: Can you create reviews for my store?
No. We never write or buy reviews. We help you collect real ones from customers and display them well, which is what platforms and shoppers expect.
I have no reviews yet. Can you still help?
Yes. We set up a review request email so your next orders bring them in, and we add other proof such as clear policies, contact details and a founder story.
Which review apps do you work with?
We work with the app you already use, or recommend a low-cost option for your platform. App fees are billed to you by the app maker.
Do you write my legal policies?

We write plain-language shipping and returns pages from the details you give us. For legal terms such as privacy and terms of service, we use your platform's generator and suggest you have a lawyer check them.
